model_name: Stockout Risk / Reorder Trigger Classification Model
algorithm: Random Forest (untuned defaults — tuning was attempted but did not improve test performance)
known_limitations: Trained on one calendar year of simulated snapshots; class balance and seasonal risk patterns may shift with real, multi-year data.
Any category with zero recall in the Section 8 stress test (see category_stress) is a blind spot this version cannot yet catch and must be disclosed explicitly, not averaged away.
The 80% recall operating threshold is a starting point, not a clinically or operationally validated target — revisit with pharmacy staff once piloted against real outcomes.
Positive class is rare (~9.8%); confidence in the exact PR-AUC figure should be treated as approximate until validated on more data.
retraining_recommendation: Retrain whenever real stockout outcome data becomes available, and re-derive the decision threshold rather than reusing this one, since the precision/recall trade-off is data-dependent.
